answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23912 Country: India Title: Can we close our eyes closed while offering salaah,if some one gets disturbed by surroundings? Question: can we close our eyes closed while offering salaah,if some one gets disturbed by surroundings Answer ID: 23912 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1146/884/L=1431) It is against sunnah and makrooh tanzihi to offer salah while shutting eyes. However, if someone is disturbed with thoughts and closes his eyes due to it, then he can do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
